Currently, 300+ children (200 boys, 100 girls) reside at the home in Hyderabad, Telangana. The home operates under the supervision of trained caregivers and complies with all child welfare regulations. Amitabha Aadarana Vidyalaya District Hyderabad Rangareddy State Telangana District Hyderabad Rangareddy States Telangana Amitabha Aadarana Vidyalaya provides free quality education to children from the lowest economic strata of society. Qualified and experienced teachers use activity-based learning, weekly assessments, and regular evaluations to ensure strong academic progress.
